The '''Nd-53 double laser cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] that saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] installed a Nd-53 double laser cannon on his [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]] a year into the Clone Wars, in place of the vehicle's passenger seat. The bike's chain-links featured built-in capacitors that provided the energy used to power both the double cannons and the clawed legs.
